page_data.en:
- 37 -

October 23. At 2 p.m. the Social Bureau held a meeting
at which Yih Hsiang-kao and Shao Hsu-bah of this
Union were present to interview Mr. Pao Kuo-hwa,
special delegate of the Ministry of Industry, and
to inform him of the true facts of the strike.
Measures to deal with the trouble were discussed.

October 24. At 3 p.m. Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General
of the S.M.C., invited Mr. Doo Yuah-mun, member of
the Council of the Chinese Municipality, to arrange
measures to cope with the dispute.

October 25. At 2 p.m. we called a meeting of various
labour unions to discuss measures to support the
strikers. A statement requesting the public support
of the S.P.C. strikers was issued.

October 26. The People's Movement Committee of the
Central Kuomintang Headquarters detailed an official
Lee Jen-tso to Shanghai to make an investigation.
He made a detailed inquiry at the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai and the local Tangpu. The circumstances
surrounding the labour trouble were closely investigated
in an interview with Chu Hsueh-van and Shao Hsu-bah,
Committee members of this Union.

October 27. The 4th District Waterworkn & Electricity
Trade Workers Union submitted five demands in addition
with reasons to Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General of
the S.M.C., through Mr. Doo Yuah-mun, thus facilitating
his intervention.

October 28. Mr. Lee Jen-tso of the People's Movement
Committee of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters
called on Mr. O.K. Yee, Chief Secretary of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai. Measures to control
the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company were
devised.
page_data.zh:
- 37 -

10月23日。下午2时，社会局举行会议，本工会的易祥高（Yih Hsiang-kao）和邵许八（Shao Hsu-bah）出席，会见了实业部特派员鲍国华先生，并向其通报罢工的真相。会上讨论了处理此次纠纷的措施。

10月24日。下午3时，工部局总办费森登先生邀请上海市参事会成员杜月笙先生，共同商讨应对此次纠纷的措施。

10月25日。下午2时，我们召集各工会开会，讨论支持罢工者的措施。并发布了一份呼吁公众支持上海电力公司罢工工人的声明。

10月26日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会派遣官员李任之（Lee Jen-tso）赴上海进行调查。他在大上海市政府和当地党部进行了详细查询。在与本工会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-van）和邵许八的面谈中，对劳工纠纷的相关情况进行了严密调查。

10月27日。第四区水电业工人工会通过杜月笙先生，向工部局总办费森登先生提交了五项要求及理由，以便其介入调解。

10月28日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会的李任之先生拜访了大上海市政府秘书长余鸿钧（O.K. Yee）先生。制定了控制上海电力公司劳工纠纷的措施。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I., Special Branch
REPORT
Date December 21 1933

Subject (in-full) Agent No.57, Recipient of Threatening Letter

Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by W. Lamean DSS

The attached letter (with translation) was delivered
through the post to the home of Sung Zuan-loong, Agent No.57,
on December 20.

A perusal of the document would lead to the belief
that the writers are connected with the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union, and being in possession of the
fact that Sung's father owns a shop, are trying their hand
at extortion.

The letter was posted either at the 6th Sub-Office
or at the 8th Sub-Office, Shanghai on December 20.

Sung on the advice of D.I. Sih Ts-liang has moved
away to another address.

Discreet enquiries are proceeding.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

SI
I have discussed this matter
with O.p. S.B. I should like
to see the agent when he returns.
If he is determined to resign we
can let him go, but, in view
of his good work, if you can find
him an elsewhere usefully we
might hold on to him.
J.R.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. B. REGI. / No. D / Date December 21 1933）
（批：FILE / 28）

主题（全称）：57号探员，收到恐吓信

由特别情报科督察戈尔德（Golder）撰写，由副特别情报科督察拉曼（Lamean）转呈

附信（附译文）于12月20日通过邮政投递至57号探员孙瑞龙（Sung Zuan-loong）的家中。

阅毕该文件使人相信，写信人与第四区水电工人工会有关联，且因知晓孙某之父拥有一家店铺，正试图进行勒索。

该信于12月20日在上海第六分局或第八分局辖区投寄。

孙某在特别情报科督察施子良（Sih Ts-liang，音译）的建议下，已搬往另一地址。

正在谨慎地进行查询。

特别情报科督察

特科主管警官。

SI
我已与此事
与特科值班警官讨论过。我希望
在该探员回来时见他一面。
如果他决心辞职，我们可以
让他离开，但鉴于他工作出色，
如果你能在别处为他找到有用的
职位，我们或许可以留住他。
J.R.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案编号 B. REGI. / 编号 D / 日期 1933年12月21日）

page_data.en:
Translation

Envelop :
Mr. Sung Zuan Loong, (孫瑞龍),
Shing Fuh Shen (興復盛) Macaroni Shop,
439 Elgin Road,
Local.

Letter :

December 18, 1933.

Brother Zuan Loong,

Yesterday we passed by the Shing Fuh Shen
and saw you taking supper inside. We intended to
come in and talk with you, but in view of the
inconvenience caused by the large number of persons
staying inside, we waited outside up to 11.30 p.m.,
when we believed you went to bed, we then departed.
We write to you this letter to open negotiations
with you. We have been looking for you for a
considerable time and now know your address. We
have not been deceived by your intrigues and as we
have been friends for over a year, you should not be
mean ~~like you do~~. Why should you be a running dog
of the employers and report our activities to them
with the result that the workers who were enthusiastic
union members were dismissed from the Company's
service ? Why should you act like that ? You
are a Chinese, why should you be a slave of the
foreigners ? Is it that you have no heart nor liver?
When the labour dispute extended to a large scale,
every day you came to obtain information from us,
which we willingly supplied you with. Fortunately,
we discovered that you were a running dog, but
you were clever enough to refrain from coming to
page_data.zh:
译文

信封：
孙瑞龙先生，(孫瑞龍)，
兴复盛面馆，
爱文义路439号，
本地。

信件：

1933年12月18日。

瑞龙兄：

昨日我们路过兴复盛，看见你在里面吃晚饭。我们本想进去和你谈谈，但鉴于屋内人多不便，我们在外面等到晚上11点半，以为你已就寝，方才离去。我们写此信是为了与你开启谈判。我们寻找你已久，现已知悉你的住址。我们没有被你的诡计所欺骗，既然我们做朋友已有一年多，你不应该如此吝啬 ~~像你那样~~。你为何要做雇主的走狗，向他们报告我们的活动，导致那些热情的工会成员被公司解雇？你为何要这样做？你是中国人，为何要做洋人的奴隶？难道你没有心肝吗？当劳资纠纷扩大规模时，你每天都来从我们这里获取情报，我们也乐意提供。幸好我们发现你是个走狗，但你很聪明，不再来

page_data.en:
- 2 -

our offices. You went to the management of the
Company to show your merits and the management seeing
that you possessed wits gave you a "running dog"
reward in the sum of $1,500. We know that you
are very happy and therefore you do not come to our
place. You should know that after dismissal,
we have not even rice to eat. We do not like to
speak much. Since you have received a big reward
from the management and we are in financial straits
you should give part of it to our labour union. You
are required to come to our union and carry out
negotiations within three days. Should you fail to
come, you should take care when you are walking in
the street. We will adopt the most severe measure
against you. You are hereby warned.

Special Warning.

N. B. The letter paper bears the following printed characters:
"Chi Chong Ziang (其昌祥 ), Shop, mouth of
Kao Zuan Li (高寿里 ). Alleyway, Elgin Road."
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

我们的办公室。你去向公司管理层邀功，管理层见你有些小聪明，给了你一笔1,500美元的“走狗”赏金。我们知道你很得意，因此不来我们这里。你应该知道，被解雇后，我们连饭都吃不上了。我们不愿多言。既然你从管理层那里得到了一大笔赏金，而我们正处于经济困境，你应该分一部分给我们的工会。限你三天内来我工会进行谈判。若你不来，走在街上时要小心。我们将对你采取最严厉的措施。特此警告。

特别警告。

注：信纸印有如下字样：
“其昌祥店，高寿里口，爱文义路弄堂。”

page_data.en:
Translation of a letter from Agent 57 of S.l, Sp. Br.
----------------------------------------------------------------

November 14, 1933.

Sir,

Owing to the suspicious and menacing attitude
of the workers of the Shanghai Power Company now on
strike, the circumstances surrounding which have been
reported to you, I have with your kind permission
suspended enquiries in connection with the case.

At 10 p.m. November 8, two of the strikers
called at my residence in Loh Kwei Faung (六桂坊), North
Chekiang Road, and looked for me. I, however, succeeded
in getting away from them.

On November 10, four of the strikers visited
the congee shop operated by my father on Elgin Road
and asked for Sung Zuan-loong (孫瑞龍), an alias I
use among the strikers. Despite the fact that a shop-
assistant informed them that I had moved away, the four
callers instructed him to tell me to be careful. They
said that Sung (i.e. myself) had received a reward of
$1,500.00 from the management of the Shanghai Power
Company and that this money should be sent to the 4th
District Water & Electricity Workers' Union for disposal.
They also instructed the shop assistant to tell me to
meet them in the Ih Loh Tien (一樂天) Teashop, Nanking
Road, at 10 a.m. on the same day (November 10). They
threatened to take "appropriate" measures against me
should I fail to attend.

On November 13, three of the strikers again
called at my father's shop on Elgin Road in search of me.
page_data.zh:
特科、特别分部57号探员来信译文
---

1933年11月14日。

先生：

由于目前罢工的上海电力公司工人态度可疑且带有威胁性，相关情况已向您汇报，经您允准，我已暂停与此案有关的调查。

11月8日晚10时，两名罢工者来到我在北浙江路六桂坊的住所找我。然而，我成功避开了他们。

11月10日，四名罢工者来到我父亲在爱文义路经营的粥店，询问孙瑞龙（孫瑞龍），这是我在罢工者中使用的化名。尽管店员告知他们我已搬走，但这四名来访者仍指示店员转告我要小心。他们说孙某（即我自己）已从上海电力公司管理层获得1,500.00美元的赏金，这笔钱应送往第四区水电工人工会处置。他们还指示店员转告我，于同日（11月10日）上午10时在南京路一乐天茶馆与他们见面。他们威胁说，如果我不到场，将对我采取“适当”措施。

11月13日，三名罢工者再次来到我父亲在爱文义路的店铺寻找我。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

in view of the above, I respectfully beg
to ask leave of absence for one month. As I received
a letter from my family at my native place, informing
me of the construction of an ancestral temple and
asking my presence there without delay, i at once
left and failed to come personally to you to apply
for leave, for which neglect i ask your pardon. My
departure to my native place was urgent and necessary
in the present case.

Agent 57 Chang Lih-Chi.

N. B. Attached to this letter is a communication
received by the agent from his grand-father
instructing him to return to his native
place without delay to attend to the
construction of an ancestral temple there.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

鉴于上述情况，我恭敬地请求休假一个月。因收到家乡家书，告知修建宗祠事宜，并要求我立即前往，我随即离开，未能亲自向您请假，对此疏忽恳请原谅。在目前情况下，我返回家乡是紧急且必要的。

57号探员 张立基（Chang Lih-Chi，音译）。

注：随信附有该探员从其祖父处收到的信函，指示他立即返回家乡处理当地宗祠的修建事宜。

use among the strikers. Despite the fact that a shop-
assistant informed them that I had moved away, the four
callers instructed him to tell me to be careful. They
said that Sung (i.e. myself) had received a reward of
$1,500.00 from the management of the Shanghai Power
Company and that this money should be sent to the 4th
District Water & Electricity Workers' Union for disposal.
They also instructed the shop assistant to tell me to
meet them in the Ih Loh Tien (一樂天) Teashop, Nanking
Road, at 10 a.m. on the same day (November 10). They
threatened to take "appropriate" measures against me
should I fail to attend.

On November 13, three of the strikers again
called at my father's shop on Elgin Road in search of me.

上海公共租界工部局警务处特别分部（S.I, Sp. Br.）第57号探员来信译文
---

1933年11月14日。

先生：

鉴于目前罢工的上海电力公司工人态度可疑且带有威胁性，相关情况已向您报告，经您允准，我已暂停与此案有关的调查。

11月8日晚10时，两名罢工者来到我在北浙江路六桂坊的住所找我。但我成功避开了他们。

11月10日，四名罢工者前往我父亲在爱而近路（Elgin Road）经营的粥店，寻找我在罢工者中使用的化名孙瑞龙（Sung Zuan-loong）。尽管店员告知他们我已搬走，但这四名来访者仍嘱咐店员转告我要小心。他们说，孙（即本人）已从上海电力公司管理层那里收到1,500.00美元的酬金，这笔钱应交给第四区水电工会处理。他们还嘱咐店员转告我，于同日（11月10日）上午10时在南京路一樂天（Ih Loh Tien）茶馆与他们见面。他们威胁说，如果我不到场，将对我采取“适当”措施。

11月13日，三名罢工者再次来到我父亲在爱而近路的店铺寻找我。

- 2 -

In view of the above, I respectfully beg
to ask leave of absence for one month. As I received
a letter from my family at my native place, informing
me of the construction of an ancestral temple and
asking my presence there without delay, I at once
left and failed to come personally to you to apply
for leave, for which neglect I ask your pardon. My
departure to my native place was urgent and necessary
in the present case.

Agent 57 Chang Lih-Chi.

N. B. Attached to this letter is a communication
received by the agent from his grand-father
instructing him to return to his native
place without delay to attend to the
construction of an ancestral temple there.

鉴于上述情况，我恳请批准休假一个月。因收到家乡家书，告知正在修建宗祠，并要求我立即回去，我随即离开，未能亲自向您请假，对此疏忽敬请原谅。在目前情况下，我返回家乡是紧急且必要的。

第57号探员 张立之（Chang Lih-Chi）。

Extract of D.S.I. Golder's Report re Shanghai Power Co.
- Situation dated November 2, 1933.

It is learned that the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union, 15 Shou Ying Faung, Tien Doong
Road, Chapei, will convene a general meeting of workers of
the Shanghai Power Company for 8 a.m. November 5 in the
Kung Woo (共舞) Cinema, West Gate.

It is further learned that the Union had decided
to request the local Kuomintang and the General Labour Union
to ask the local Chinese Military authorities to deal severely
with one Sun Zuan-loong (孫鑽龍) for impersonating a
reporter of the China Times and seeking information anent
the activities of the strikers. The Union, it is alleged,
has asked the local Kuomintang and the General Labour Union
to be responsible for the safety of some ten important members
of the Union, whose names were copied and are in the possession
of the spy, and to see that none be discharged when the workers
resume work.

At 8 p.m. November 1, four Chinese of the labouring
type called at 415 Elgin Road (the home of the father of Chang
Sao-mei) and enquiries as to the whereabouts of Chang Sao-mei
(張少梅) which is the real name of Soong Zuan Loong. Later,
these men visited the residence of Chang Sao Mei at 5 Loh Kwei
Faung, North Chekiang Road, where they remained for some time,
leaving when Chang did not put in an appearance.

Agent 51 visited the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union on November 1 and was told to refrain from
attending the Union for any information pending investigation
into his position. He was also informed that the Union would
not be responsible for any untoward accident should he ignore
the advice. It will be remembered that Agent 51 impersonated
a reporter of the Hwa Tung News Agency.

特别分部督察高尔德（D.S.I. Golder）关于上海电力公司情况的报告摘录
- 日期为1933年11月2日。

获悉，位于闸北天通庵路寿盈坊15号的第四区水电工会，将于11月5日上午8时在西门共舞（Kung Woo）电影院召开上海电力公司工人大会。

另获悉，该工会已决定请求当地国民党部和总工会，要求当地中国军事当局严厉惩处一名叫孙钻龙（Sun Zuan-loong）的人，因其冒充《时报》（China Times）记者，搜集有关罢工者活动的情报。据称，工会已请求当地国民党部和总工会负责保障约十名工会重要成员的安全，这些成员的姓名已被抄录并由该线人掌握；并确保在工人复工时，无人被解雇。

11月1日晚8时，四名劳工模样的中国人来到爱而近路415号（张少梅父亲的家），询问张少梅（Chang Sao-mei）的下落，此即宋钻龙（Soong Zuan Loong）的真名。随后，这些人又前往北浙江路六桂坊5号张少梅的住所，在那里停留了一段时间，因张未露面而离开。

11月1日，第51号探员访问了第四区水电工会，被告知在其身份接受调查期间，不得前往工会获取任何信息。他还被告知，如果他不听从劝告，工会将不对任何意外事故负责。需指出的是，第51号探员曾冒充华通通讯社（Hwa Tung News Agency）记者。
